Changelog

Source: NEWS.md

ispideployment 2.0.0

First versioned release of this repository. It replaces the earlier layout (database dumps, batch calculator, separate README guides) with:

  • Images pinned: I-SPI 1.1.1, i-spi-compute API and worker 1.1.1 (curveRcore 0.7.0, curveRfreq 0.5.2, curveRbayes 0.5.2, curveRweights 0.3.0, CmdStan 2.40.0), Redis 7.4, PostgreSQL 17.2 in the cluster manifest and 16 in the local stack.
  • db/: a curated schema for a new, empty database (calib schema 0.7.0) with seeded settings, instead of pg_dump files. db/MANIFEST.md lists every object and where it comes from.
  • k8s-manifests/: public templates with placeholders and no secrets. I-SPI reaches i-spi-compute inside the cluster. An optional second compute tier is in i-spi-compute-sim.yml. The batch calculator is removed.
  • local/: a Docker Compose stack (PostgreSQL, Dex, Redis, i-spi-compute, I-SPI) that runs on one machine.
  • tests/ and CI: the schema loads into an empty PostgreSQL, the manifests and Compose file are checked for pinned and consistent versions, and an end-to-end run fits a curve through the local stack.
  • Documentation site built with pkgdown: overview, local, cluster, cloud (provider-neutral) and air-gapped installs, configuration, database schema, upgrading, and checks.

i-spi-compute 1.1.1 fixes a 1.1.0 worker bug: Bayesian fits saved without posterior draws (the default) stored no back-calculated standard or control estimates. See Upgrading for how to fill them in for fits made on 1.1.0.

Developed by Michael S. Zens.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
